hypothesis: The retrospective one-paired-seed ACK classifier uses a fixed-action-response prototype and may fail when the actual known native control amplitude changes. A predeclared action-conditioned affine response prototype may improve controlled public-proprioception inference without target-state reads.
evidence_stage: NEW prospectively fixed PhysX test with original raw complete denominators; source hypotheses informed by earlier same-command analyses. Not an entirely unmotivated blind discovery.

true_physx_evaluation.fault: unknown acknowledgment at t2; actual dispatched t2 is scaled native arm command when applied and native zero when held; BOTH visibly commanded t3 native zero
true_physx_evaluation.scope: 2 robots x 4 distinct new reset seeds each x 2 scales x 2 physical delivery truths = 32 task-free actual source conditions; each condition simulated for six independent comparator controllers

methods_fixed_before_testing.zero_shot_foreign_model: Other robot's full eight-paired-seed original response model without target-robot calibration, no action scaling
methods_fixed_before_testing.one_paired_seed_fixed_model: Recenter each class prototype on first target-robot labelled prior seed, retain source radius floor and 2mm original historical margin
methods_fixed_before_testing.one_paired_seed_action_conditioned: Same one-paired-seed local centers, but scale APPLIED class center mu_held+s*(mu_applied-mu_held); held class mean unchanged. No fitted new parameters. No privileged state read in decision.
methods_fixed_before_testing.blind_optimistic: Assume applied regardless of public motion
methods_fixed_before_testing.blind_pessimistic: Assume held regardless of public motion
methods_fixed_before_testing.one_privileged_target_read: Exactly one authoritative controller target read at t3 boundary, then calculate physically legal native correction; not equal-information and is an oracle upper reference

outcome_metrics: wrong confident ACK history labels for every public classifier
actual post-physx controller commanded target XYZ restored within 1e-4m
one_privileged_target_read counts during decision vs zero of other five arms
every actual seed/truth/scale and physical probe dispatch/fault exposure; no exclusions
model residual/out-of-envelope cases and native unrepresentable actions
mandatory_reporting: Do not claim novel across-robot learned PPO transfer; these are scripted native PickCube controller signals
One paired seed means 2 labelled calibration episodes with known applied vs held truth, not zero-shot
Under distribution shift the action-conditioned linear response model is only empirical and may fail
Any missed fault or corrective command refusal is counted with original seed, never excluded
Data must be source-audited independent of owner PhysX runner before a positive claim
No real robot, actual network packet-loss, dynamics attestation, trajectory/collision force safety or third-party scientific endorsement
